data: NVIDIA's operating income rose from **$4,224 million in fiscal 2023** (year ended January 29, 2023) to **$81,453 million in fiscal 2025** (year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of **about 1,828%**, so operating income in fiscal 2025 was roughly 19.3 times the fiscal 2023 level. Fiscal 2023 was held down partly by a $1,353 million acquisition termination cost. The main driver of the rise was revenue, which grew from $26,974 million to $130,497 million over the same period.
